display_title: Hotel Christmas Short Story: Penis Navida
description:
On Christmas Eve, bell boy Eunchan meets his favorite actor Jae, in the hotel he's working for. Jae wants to practice his script with his manager but his manager ditched him for a holiday vacation. Desperate to have a script reading partner, he enlists the help of Eunchan. Something interesting happens after their script reading...

***Note:**  
Part of Penis Navida: [Hotel XMAS](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=3350491531) 2020 event by Bomtoon, this is Story 7 (Ch.23-25) on Lezhin*
